title: Barn sliders and farmhouse Dutch doors
body: Red Barn has two openings for two different jobs. The braced ground doors hang from a long black rail. Look up the gable and there’s a smaller pair of hinged hayloft doors. The two farmhouses use a split Dutch door, with a horizontal rail where the upper and lower leaves meet.
